title: Scoped agent task governance
objective: Add scoped R&D agent instructions and pure task-intake/handoff checks without granting task acceptance or operational authority.
success_criteria: Agents receive scoped R&D instructions and explicit human handoffs
New-task intake rejects mismatched approval declarations and unsafe paths
Machine PASS cannot create acceptance, merge or promotion authority
stop_conditions: Any change to frozen or operational paths
Any claim that an unsigned approval record authenticates a human
Any automatic task acceptance, merge, promotion or trading authority
